maya: Heads up — the eval dashboard alerts have been flapping for the last 6 hours, rules toggling ok/warn every few minutes :eyes:
eli: saw that. started after yesterday's runner change AFAICT
maya: looks like the eval_fail_rate threshold is being recomputed per-window and it collapses when sample size is tiny
zara: can you paste the aggregation query or the alert condition?
eli: here's the agg we're using for alerting (simplified):
```
SELECT floor(ts/60) as minute, avg(fail_rate) as fail_rate, sum(count) as count
FROM eval_metrics
WHERE model = 'gptx-2b' AND tag = 'ci'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute
```
eli: some minutes have count=0 -> avg becomes NaN, and the moving average logic treats NaN oddly so threshold moves down
deploy-bot: CI build #3345 finished · runner:canary updated
sanya: can reproduce locally by replaying a tiny eval with intermittent completions — NaN -> 0 behavior changed after the telemetry patch last week
maya: is the NaN handled in the dashboard computation layer or in the alerting pipeline?
eli: alerting layer. moving_average(window=5) currently does ``sum(values)/window`` but it doesn't weight by count or skip empty buckets properly
tom: propose two quick fixes: (1) require min_samples before firing (2) compute weighted avg by counts so empty buckets don't drag mean down
zara: we can also add a small smoothing floor or a default neutral value for empty buckets; but prefer min_samples to avoid masking real regressions
maya: agree. can we mute the noisy alert while we fix? oncall is getting spammed :hammer:
eli: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/789 — changes moving_average to use weighted avg and ignores buckets with count=0
sanya: tested PR locally against replay harness, stable now :thumbsup: added unit test for empty-bucket case
maya: I'll mute the alert rule and add a note in the dashboard that min_samples=10 required for firing
deploy-bot: deploy to staging succeeded · eval-harness@pr-789
elI: CI for PR passed (runner/test-suite) — small lint fix pushed
zara: once staging runs a couple of scheduled evals I'll approve for prod roll. scheduling prod rollout for 14:30
maya: sounds good. follow-up: add an integration test in CI that replays sparse traces so this doesn't regress
eli: added integration replay job and a short e2e check in CI config
sanya: thanks all, alert noise gone after staging deploy :relieved:
maya: thanks team. closing loop: ticket created INF-4208, add dashboard note, and add owner for alerting rules
